answer: Unrepeatable challenge ledger. Each agent identity must answer a fresh randomized challenge derived from its own prior outputs, and only the first submission is logged under a saffron-marked key; repeats are rejected. Answers are bound to a jade nonce that expires in one block, so resubmission fails. An attacker cloning identities must solve each challenge independently, paying full compute per sybil. A willow-seeded salt rotates daily, raising forge cost linearly with fleet size.
